answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake, joins the Semaphore zero-knowledge tree, and evaluates an epoch polynomial whose identity is bound by a polynomial commitment. RLN permits one rate-limited message per epoch while preserving anonymity: a nebula-tagged whisper carries a hidden Shamir share with an anchor binding to the member proof. Duplicate messaging exposes enough distinct shares to reconstruct the private key, triggering instantaneous collateral slashing.
